title: MCP Gateway
summary: Use your workspace's connectors from Claude Code, Cursor, and any other MCP client.
body_markdown:
Your team's context lives in tools like Linear, Jira, and Slack. With the MCP Gateway, your coding agents can reach all of them through the Sourcebot MCP server with admin controls built in. Choose from more than 30[supported connectors](https://docs.sourcebot.dev/docs/features/connectors/overview#supported-connectors) , or add any remote MCP server as a[custom connector](https://docs.sourcebot.dev/docs/features/connectors/add-a-connector#custom-connectors) .


- **Scoped to you** : each member signs in with their own account, so a connector only returns data they can see. Credentials stay in Sourcebot and never reach the MCP client.
- **Discoverability** : agents already know which connectors are available in the workspace. When a member isn't signed in to one yet, agents can show them a sign-in link.
- **Admin control** : owners choose which connectors and tools agents can use. Changes apply right away.


See the[docs](https://docs.sourcebot.dev/docs/mcp/gateway) to get started.


## Audit log viewer


Owners can now browse audit logs in **Settings → Workspace → Audit Log** , filtering by person and event. Audit logs now record more events, including sign-ins, access tokens, SCIM membership, and more. Available on the Enterprise plan. See the[docs](https://docs.sourcebot.dev/docs/configuration/audit-logs) .


## Improved analytics


The analytics page has a redesigned active users chart, which you can view by day, week, or month and break down by feature. A new usage leaderboard shows each member's active days, searches, Ask messages, and MCP tool calls. Available on the Pro plan. See the[docs](https://docs.sourcebot.dev/docs/features/analytics) .


---


Added


-


API


Added` includeTotalCount` and` includeRefs` query parameters to` GET /api/commits` that skip counting every matching commit and looking up each commit's branches and tags, both of which are slow on large repositories.
-


Audit logs


Audit records now include` actorLabel` and` targetLabel` , the display names of the actor and target when the event was recorded.
-


Code browsing


Added repository home pages at` /browse/<repo>` , which show the README at the repository's root.
-


Indexing


Added` revisions.overrides` to connection configs, allowing different branches and tags to be indexed for specific repositories.
-


Knowledge Base


Added a View knowledge base action to repository menus in Knowledge Base settings to open generated documentation in a new tab, including after a later failed scan.
-


Knowledge Base


Added reasoning effort for Amazon Bedrock Claude and OpenAI models in Knowledge Base stages.
-


MCP


The Sourcebot MCP server now tells MCP clients what its tools are for when they connect.
-


Permission syncing


Added user-driven permission syncing for Azure DevOps Cloud through Microsoft Entra OAuth.
-


Sign-in & members


Added server-side telemetry for how members join an instance (invite link, email invite, approved request, auto-join, SCIM).


Changed


-


API


A request whose` Authorization` token is rejected now falls back to a valid` X-Sourcebot-Api-Key` header. Previously, only an unknown or expired OAuth token or an invalid Bearer API key fell back.
-


Audit logs


Removed the` SOURCEBOT_EE_AUDIT_LOGGING_ENABLED` environment variable. Audit logging is now always enabled, and audit logs are always pruned according to` SOURCEBOT_EE_AUDIT_RETENTION_DAYS` .
-


Connectors


Removed the Needs approval tool permission. Connector tools are now Allowed or Blocked, new tools start Allowed, and tools that previously needed approval are now Allowed.
-


Indexing


Updated the bundled Zoekt version.
-


Knowledge Base


Knowledge Base stages without a chosen reasoning effort now use` high` when their model supports it, and Discovery and Overview no longer inherit the Survey effort.
-


Language models


Upgraded the AI SDK to` ai`` ^6.0.309` and the latest v6 provider packages.
-


Settings


Renamed the Ask Sourcebot settings pages to Connectors and the Connections settings page to Code Hosts, and moved shared skills to their own page. Old URLs redirect.
-


Sign-in & members


Improved logging for the Bitbucket Server OAuth flow.


Removed


-


Audit logs


Removed usage events from the audit log:` user.performed_code_search` ,` user.performed_find_references` ,` user.performed_goto_definition` ,` user.created_ask_chat` ,` user.listed_repos` ,` user.fetched_file_source` ,` user.fetched_file_tree` , and` user.fetched_file_blame` . Existing records stay available through the audit API until the retention policy removes them.


Fixed


-


Ask Sourcebot


Fixed chat page titles repeating "Sourcebot".
-


Ask Sourcebot


Fixed OpenAI models in Ask Sourcebot filling in every optional connector tool argument, which made connectors reject the call.
-


Ask Sourcebot


Fixed private chats showing "Private Chat" as the browser tab title to people who can view them, instead of the chat's name.
-


Ask Sourcebot


Fixed oversized Ask Sourcebot tool results causing model requests to fail.
-


Code browsing


Fixed slow file previews on repositories with long histories, which loaded and counted the file's entire commit history even while the History panel was closed.
-


Connectors


Fixed adding a connector failing when its OAuth server advertises more than 200 scopes.
-


Connectors


Fixed connectors requesting every OAuth scope the connector advertises instead of the scopes chosen when adding the connector.
-


Connectors


Fixed owners who haven't connected a connector being unable to see or manage its tools.
-


Connectors


Fixed adding a duplicate connector not being rejected until after the OAuth scopes step.
-


Knowledge Base


Fixed Knowledge Base scans failing with "prompt is too long" when an agent searched a repository with minified or generated files, with read tools now cutting long lines, paging through files, and capping each result as the Ask Sourcebot and MCP tools do.
-


Knowledge Base


Fixed Knowledge Base action menu icon spacing to match repository and connection menus.
-


Knowledge Base


Fixed application navigation freezing after viewing Knowledge Base run logs.
-


Knowledge Base


Fixed Knowledge Base scan failures hiding their cause, with job logs now keeping an error's cause, aggregated errors, and fields such as its HTTP status, and scan errors summarizing the agent failures behind them.
-


Knowledge Base


Fixed Knowledge Base usage going unrecorded when the database was briefly unreachable, with usage now recorded after every step so a scan stopped by its budget no longer shows less usage than the budget.
-


Knowledge Base


Fixed Knowledge Base scans retrying output-limit failures and re-running failing full scans every day, with repeatedly failing full scans now backing off while scheduled scans run as delta scans.
-


Knowledge Base


Fixed a React error when choosing a reasoning effort on the Knowledge Base configuration page.
-


Language models


Fixed Amazon Bedrock Claude models never using prompt caching, which made Knowledge Base scans and Ask Sourcebot resend every step's full history at full price.
-


Language models


Fixed Amazon Bedrock Claude responses being cut off at 4,096 output tokens, with thinking now on by default and a new` maxOutputTokens` option to override the output limit.
-


MCP


Fixed OAuth client registration returning server errors for malformed JSON or unsupported content types.
-


MCP


Fixed MCP clients not starting a new session after the Sourcebot MCP server restarts.
-


MCP


Fixed the MCP server's sign-in challenge naming the OAuth metadata parameter` resource_metadata_uri` instead of` resource_metadata` , which kept MCP clients from finding where to sign in.
-


Sign-in & members


Fixed signing in from a link, such as a search or Ask URL, going to the home page instead of the page you opened.
